audit_events_actor_identity_check.name: audit_events_actor_identity_check
audit_events_actor_identity_check.value: ("audit_events"."actor_role" = 'system' AND "audit_events"."actor_id" IS NULL) OR ("audit_events"."actor_role" IN ('assistant', 'doctor') AND "audit_events"."actor_id" IS NOT NULL)

patients_display_name_check.name: patients_display_name_check
patients_display_name_check.value: "patients"."display_name" = 'ผู้ป่วยทดสอบ ' || substr("patients"."hn", 6)

intake_blood_pressure_relationship_check.name: intake_blood_pressure_relationship_check
intake_blood_pressure_relationship_check.value: "intake_observations"."systolic_mmhg" IS NULL OR "intake_observations"."diastolic_mmhg" IS NULL OR "intake_observations"."systolic_mmhg" >= "intake_observations"."diastolic_mmhg"
